coverage.finding: Confirmed as a real defect in the source, 2026-09-11, by recomputing the published percentages against the published ultimate strengths: ASA sigma_R 16.82 MPa, so the stated "25 % = 8 MPa" fatigue limit should be 4.2 MPa; PC sigma_R 61.6 MPa, so "7 % = 3.6 MPa" should be 4.3 MPa; PC-ABS sigma_R 52.7 MPa, so "15 % = 4.7 MPa" should be 7.9 MPa. Only PA12 is self-consistent (17 % x 43.4 = 7.4 MPa). The percentage-derived limits and the absolute stresses cannot both be right, so the existing conservative handling stands: retain measured stress and cycle observations only, and continue to reject the percentage-derived limits and the "infinite life" language (a 1e6-cycle run-out is right-censored). Authors should still be contacted for the raw data.
